newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank/Greece independence bill goes to parliament.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Greece independence bill goes to parliament.

text.p: Greece's National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou will bring to parliament on Thursday a draft bill on the independence of the Bank of Greece, the country's central bank, a national economy official told Reuters.
Papandoniou is going to hold a press conference at 1230 local (0930 GMT) on the subject, the official said.
The Maastricht Treaty requires that legislation on the independence of national central banks be passed by end-1997. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
